ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between low-intensity (dark gray/black) fluke surface and high-intensity (white/overexposed) background and sky. Interior surface displays localized high-intensity white circular markers against the dark substrate.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of high-contrast white annular (ring-shaped) and circular blobs across the entire visible dark surface of both fluke lobes. Higher density of these blobs is observed towards the distal tips and lower leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees at the vertical axis of symmetry.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency jagged peaks and valleys; serration amplitude varies significantly across the span, appearing most pronounced on the inner-half of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tapering distal tips; leading edge exhibits a broad convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed spatial clusters of high-contrast white circular and ring-like pixel patterns (consistent with barnacle attachment/scars) distributed globally across the visible ventral fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the fluke surface; irregular, non-uniform serrations on the trailing edge indicating potential historical tissue wear or growth anomalies.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high concentration of annular scarring covering a significant percentage of the visible pixel area, combined with high-frequency jaggedness of the trailing boundary.
